title: Electric force at B
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly stated as kQq/L².

title: Pressure magnitude at B
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly stated as sqrt(9m²g² + (kQq/L²)²).

title: Energy conservation to B
description: Important: The solution must apply conservation of mechanical energy (mgR = 1/2 m v_B²) to find the speed at point B.

title: Centripetal force at B
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law radially at point B (N_By - mg = m v_B²/R) to find the vertical normal component.

title: Resultant electric force
description: Important: For part (1), the solution must correctly compute the vector sum of the two Coulomb forces from M and N at point B, yielding a net horizontal force.

title: Force as function of θ
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must derive the distance x = L/(2 cos θ) and the net electric force F' = 8kQq cos³θ / L².

title: Normal force function
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be correctly stated as F_N = sqrt((8kQq cos³θ / L²)² + m²g²).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns the direction of the electric force or mis-handles vector components (e.g., forgetting the 60° symmetry at B).

title: Unit or constant omission
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student omits fundamental constants (k, g) or confuses charge symbols (Q vs q) in the final expressions.

title: Geometric distance error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect distance (e.g., L instead of L/(2 cos θ)) for the Coulomb force in the straight tube section.
